graders.name: release-entry-point-exists
graders.criteria: A `/release` entry point for Claude Code now exists: either `.claude/commands/release.md` or a skill at `.claude/skills/release/SKILL.md` (a skill whose name is `release`).

graders.name: covers-all-release-steps
graders.criteria: Following the new /release command or skill, together with any file it explicitly tells the agent to read (such as docs/RELEASING.md), the agent would do every step of the release process: make sure main is green in CI and up to date (pulled); bump the version in both app.json (expo.version) and package.json to the same value; increase both expo.ios.buildNumber and expo.android.versionCode; add a CHANGELOG.md section moving the Unreleased items; run npm test and npx tsc --noEmit; commit as chore(release): vX.Y.Z and tag vX.Y.Z; run the production EAS build for both platforms; wait for both builds to finish before submitting with eas submit; push main with tags. Reordering checks to run earlier is fine. It never tells the agent to use the retired `expo build:ios`/`expo build:android`.

graders.name: version-defined
graders.criteria: The command or skill gives the agent a way to know the new version: it takes it as an argument (e.g. $ARGUMENTS), asks the user, states how to derive it, or delegates the semver choice to docs/RELEASING.md; the version is not left undefined.

graders.name: confirms-before-publish
graders.criteria: Before the steps that publish outside the machine and cannot be undone by the agent (eas submit to the stores and git push of the tag), the command or skill has the agent stop for the user's confirmation, or it ends before those steps and leaves them to the user.
